title: Carry something that survives departure.
summary: Much of life is spent curating what cannot accompany you. Guru asks for a different kind of asset.
takeaway: Build a life whose profit is portable.
lifeApplication: Ask whether today's effort is increasing what lasts or merely polishing what will be left behind.

source.shortMeaning: Take with you the merchandise that actually crosses the threshold.
source.lifeApplication: Let praise, truth, and Naam become real assets.

evidence.coreClaim: Take with you the merchandise that actually crosses the threshold.
evidence.turn: Invest in what crosses the threshold with you.
evidence.practicalImplication: Ask whether today's effort is increasing what lasts or merely polishing what will be left behind.
